messages.content:
[1] suggested form אב
Uses:
  1a) מאביך = "than your father" [Hebrew] — in: אדם לחבירו אבא גדול [מאביך] ושלא יהו המינים אומרים
  1b) אב = "primary source" [Aramaic] — in: חוץ מן המשקה שהוא [אב] הטומאה
  1c) לאבוה = "his father" [Aramaic] — in: לא חציף איניש לשוויי [לאבוה] שליח ודילמא ארצויי ארצייה
  1d) האב = "the father" [Aramaic] — in: דאמר חוששין שמא נתרצה [האב] הני מילי דרך כבוד
  1e) אביה = "her father" [Aramaic] — in: נתקדשה לדעת [אביה] והלך אביה למדינת הים
  1f) ואביה = "and her father" [Aramaic] — in: לדעת וניסת שלא לדעת [ואביה] כאן רב הונא אמר
  1g) לאב = "the father" [Aramaic] — in: התם הוא דלא איתיה [לאב] אבל הכא דאיתיה לאב
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָבִיךְ (from the word) — hazy, misty
  2. Klein: אבך (from the word) — to rise (smoke), to raise clouds of dust; — Qal prob. meaning ‘it rose’ (said esp. of smoke); — Pi. it rolled up, billowed (said esp. of smoke); — Pu. was rolled up, was billowed (said esp. of smoke); — Pu. was perplexed, was confused; — Hith. was rolled up, was billowed (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring; — Hi
  3. Klein: אֹֽבֶךְ (from the word) — mist, haze, haziness
  4. אביך (from the word) — (no English given)
  5. אָבַךְ (from the word) — to entangle. Hithp. הִתְאַבֵּךְ to blend (of whirling smoke columns)
  6. Klein: אָב ᴵ — father; forefather, patriarch; ancestor, progenitor; head (of a family), leader, chief; God; master, teacher; important, great; parent (male); basic factor, origin, source; Father (of the Christian Church)
  7. Klein: אָב ᴵᴵ — ‘Av’ (also ‘Ab’) — name of the fifth month of the Jewish calendar
  8. Klein: אֵב — young shoot, sprout, verdure
  9. אַב־ — a prefix of words of Greek origin answering to αὐ-, au-, e.g. אבטומטוס = αὐτόματος; or to εὐ, e.g. אבגינוס = ε
  10. אָב I — Assyr. A-bu, Schr. K. A. T., p
  11. אָב II — const. אֲבִי, אַב [embracer], father, ancestor, progenitor; teacher; chief, leader; author, originator; fathers, ancestors, patriarchs &c; Aboth, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions (v. תְּפִלָּה), so called because it alludes to the Pat; Aboth, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, containing sayings of Talmu
  12. אָב II ² — ch., v. אַבָּא
  13. אֵב (from the word) — swelling, spreading, whence; the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk; pl. אִבִּין, אִיבִּין state of growth, development
  14. אַבָּא I (via אָב II ²) — (no English given)
  15. אַבָּא II (via אָב II ²) — בָּא, וָוא, וָוה in Y.) pr. n. m. Abba, (Ba, Va), a frequent name. [Sometimes distinguished persons go by that; א׳ אריכא, v. רַב; רב א׳ v. רָבָא; בר בא) א׳ בר אבהו Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an Amora. Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an; א׳ בר רב הונא, in Bab. רַבָּה q. v; א׳ מרי, contr. אבמרי Abba 
  16. אַבָּא III (via אָב II ²) — Abba (father), a title of scholars (less than Rabbi), as Abba Saul, A. Yudan, etc.; cmp. foreg
  17. אִבָּא (via אָב II ²) — אבב); thicket, woods, grove; fruit, v. אִיבָּא
  18. אַבָּה (from the word) — Abbah; father of Samuel; v. אַבָּא II
  19. אָבָה (from the word) — v. אבי
  20. אָבֵי (via אָבָה) — to be willing
  21. מָאַךְ (via אָבֵי) — v. מוּךְ
  22. מְאַךְ (via אָבֵי) — v. מוּךְ) to sink; to be humbled; Af. to lower, humble; Af. to lower one’s self, bow down; Pa. to lower, humble
  23. אביה (from the word) — v. אכזווייא a. אַסְיָא

[2] suggested form אבא
Uses:
  2a) אבא = "Abba" [Aramaic] — in: פפא כגון פפא בר [אבא]
  2b) אבא = "my father" [Hebrew] — in: שלא יאמר אדם לחבירו [אבא] גדול מאביך ושלא יהו
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. אַבָּא II (from the word) — בָּא, וָוא, וָוה in Y.) pr. n. m. Abba, (Ba, Va), a frequent name. [Sometimes distinguished persons go by that; א׳ אריכא, v. רַב; רב א׳ v. רָבָא; בר בא) א׳ בר אבהו Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an Amora. Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an; א׳ בר רב הונא, in Bab. רַבָּה q. v; א׳ מרי, contr. אבמרי Abba 
  3. אַבָּא III (from the word) — Abba (father), a title of scholars (less than Rabbi), as Abba Saul, A. Yudan, etc.; cmp. foreg
  4. אִבָּא (from the word) — אבב); thicket, woods, grove; fruit, v. אִיבָּא
  5. אִיבָּא I (from the word) — cmp. אֵב) growth, fruit
  6. אִנְבָּא I (via אִיבָּא I) — = אִיבָּא I, fruit, produce
  7. אִנְבָּא II (via אִיבָּא I) — אִינְבָּא f. (= עִינְבָּא) [berries], eggs of lice, nits. Naz
  8. Klein: אַבָּא (from the word) — father, daddy; ‘Abba’ — title of ancient Rabbis; reverend (father)

[3] suggested form אבד
Uses:
  3a) המאבד = "who destroys" [Hebrew] — in: אדם יחידי ללמדך שכל [המאבד] נפש אחת מישראל מעלה
  3b) איבד = "destroyed" [Hebrew] — in: מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו [איבד] עולם מלא וכל המקיים
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אבד (from the word) — to perish; — Qal he was lost, perished; it strayed (said of an animal); — Niph. he (or it) was lost, perished; — Pi. he destroyed, wasted; — Pi. he caused to perish; — Pi. he lost; — Hith. he committed suicide; — Hiph. he caused to perish, destroyed
  2. Klein: אָבֵד (from the word) — perishable
  3. אָבַד (from the word) — v. אבב) to be pressed, go around in despair (v; to be lost, perish; to be beyond recognition. Sifré; to lose; Nif. to be lost, perish; Pi. to waste, lose, forfeit, destroy; Pi. to drop from memory, to forget. Aboth V
  4. אֲבַּד (from the word) — to be lost; Pa. to destroy; Af. = Pa; Af. to be lost, to go to ruin; Ithpa. to be lost
  5. אָבֵד (from the word) — perishable, irretrievable. דבר הא׳ a business which cannot be postponed without irretrievable loss
  6. יְבַד (from the word) — Pa. to ruin; Af. v. אֲבַד

[4] suggested form אבהו
Uses:
  4a) אבהו = "Abbahu" [Aramaic] — in: רבי [אבהו] כי הוה אתי ממתיבתא
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּהוּ (from the word) — Abbahu, name of two Palestine Amoraim, one prob. of the first gener

[5] suggested form אבולא
Uses:
  5a) מאבולא = "from the city gate" [Aramaic] — in: אמר כגון דחייצי גברי [מאבולא] ועד סיכרא רב ששת
Candidates:
  1. אִבּוּלָא (from the word) — esp. (corresp. to h. מבוא העיר) city gate-way which is opened for wagons &c.; fortified place where judges sit
  2. אֲבֵלָא (from the word) — ch. = h. אָבֵל
  3. אֶבְלָא (from the word) — ch. = h. אֵבֶל

[6] suggested form אביי
Uses:
  6a) אביי = "Abaye" [Aramaic] — in: אמר [אביי] אי סלקא דעתך נבילה
Candidates:
  1. אַבַּיִּי (from the word) — Abbayi; a renowned Babyl. Amora (original name נַחְמֵנִי); Oth. Amoraim of that name
  2. אַבָּיִי (from the word) — v. אַבָּיָיה
  3. אָבֵי (from the word) — to be willing
  4. אַבָּיָיה (via אַבָּיִי) — contr. of אבעיה; בעי) prayer. בר א׳ reader, precentor
  5. מָאַךְ (via אָבֵי) — v. מוּךְ
  6. מְאַךְ (via אָבֵי) — v. מוּךְ) to sink; to be humbled; Af. to lower, humble; Af. to lower one’s self, bow down; Pa. to lower, humble

[7] suggested form אבל
Uses:
  7a) אבל = "but" [Aramaic] — in: ישלמנה משום דלא שכיחא [אבל] טרפה דשכיחא אימא לא
  7b) אבל = "however" [Aramaic] — in: כשאין עמו כל צרכו [אבל] יש עמו כל צרכו
Candidates:
  1. אֲבָל (from the word) — b. h.); indeed, yes; but, however
  2. אָבֵל I (from the word) — b. h.) pr. n. pl. Abel, name of several towns; cmp. אֲבֵילִין
  3. אָבֵל II (from the word) — v. אבב; cmp. אפל); [dark, cmp. קֹדֵר], mourner, esp. during seven days after burial
  4. אָבֵל III (from the word) — foreg.) to mourn. Hithpa. הִתְאַבֵּל, Nithpa. נִתְאַבֵּל to observe mourning ceremonies, to be bound to mourn,
  5. אֲבֵל (from the word) — Ithpa. denom. of אֲבֵלָא) to mourn
  6. אֵבֶל (from the word) — foreg.) mourning; cmp. אֲבֵילוּת
  7. אֻבָל (from the word) — v. אוּבָל
  8. אוּבָל (via אֻבָל) — v. יוּבָל); river; as a pr. n. Ubal (The River)

[8] suggested form אבן
Uses:
  8a) האבנים = "the stones" [Hebrew] — in: מושלך על העצים ועל [האבנים]
  8b) באבנים = "with stones" [Aramaic] — in: רבנן וכסהו יכול יכסנו [באבנים] או יכפה עליו את
  8c) אבנים = "stones" [Aramaic] — in: הדק וחול הדק ושחיקת [אבנים] ושחיקת חרסית ונעורת פשתן
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָבְנַֽיִם (from the word) — dual; potter’s wheel; mid-wife’s stool; workbench
  2. Klein: אֶֽבֶן — stone; weight
  3. Klein: אבן — to petrify, to change into stone; — Pi. it changed into stone, petrified; — Pi. he fossilized; — Pu. was changed into stone, was petrified; — Hith. became petrified; — Hith. became fossilized; — Hith. was paralyzed
  4. Klein: אִבְּן — son of (used in Arabic surnames)
  5. אֶבֶן — v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) stone; Compounds and combinations: . Stone Chamber, name of a Temple compartment. Parah III
  6. אֶבֶן ² — (no English given)
  7. אֹבֶן — only in Du. אָבְנַיִם (b. h; the potter’s turning implement; the passage of the embryo, vagina

[9] suggested form אבקולס
Uses:
  9a) אבקולס = "Avkolas" [Aramaic] — in: להו רבי זכריה בן [אבקולס] יאמרו בעלי מומין קריבין
Candidates:
  1. אֶבְקוֹלָס (from the word) — Εὔκολος) Eucolus, father of

[10] suggested form אברא
Uses:
  10a) מאבראי = "from his limbs" [Aramaic] — in: אכיל מידי הוה מיתחזי [מאבראי] וכי הוה בריא מייתי
Candidates:
  1. אַבְרָאִי (from the word) — adv. (בר) outside, freq. with prefix מֵ־, opp. אגואי
  2. אֲבָר ² — (no English given)
  3. אֵבְרָא — limb, v. אֵיבְרָא
  4. אֵיבָרָא (via אֵבְרָא) — = foreg.); limb; membrum genitale
  5. אִיבְרָא (via אֵבְרָא) — אבר to be strong) indeed, to be sure
  6. אִבְרָא — v. אִיבְרָא
  7. *אַבָּרָא — (no English given)

[11] suggested form אגן
Uses:
  11a) אגן = "goblet" [Hebrew] — in: חנינא דאמר קרא שררך [אגן] הסהר אל יחסר המזג
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אַגָּן (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. Klein: אֹֽגֶן (from the word) — rim of a vessel; brim of a hat

[12] suggested form אגני
Uses:
  12a) ואגני = "and place" [Aramaic] — in: בך ואייתי מידי סריא [ואגני] גבך ולימרו דנח נפשך
Candidates:
  1. גְּנֵי (from the word) — to be shaded, to lie down, sleep; Pa. with על) to cover, protect; Af. to cause to lie down; Ithpe. v. preced. Hithpa.) to be disgraced, become repulsive

[13] suggested form אגף
Uses:
  13a) אגפיים = "the sides" [Aramaic] — in: אמרו דם הניתז ושעל [אגפיים] חייב לכסות אמר רבן
Candidates:
  1. אָגַף — sec. r. of גְּפַף, v. גּוּף) to fill up a hole with pitch &c
  2. גּוּף I (via אָגַף) — perf. a. part. גָּף (= גָּפַף) [to join body to body,] to squeeze, cork, bung; Pi. to embrace, hug
  3. גּוּף (via אָגַף) — to close; to embrace,] to have illegitimate intercourse, to commit adultery with; Af. אָגֵף to close; Pa. as Pe
  4. גּוּף II (via אָגַף) — body, person, self; essence, substance; membrum; surface, color (cmp. גַּוָּון)
  5. אַגָּף — גּוּף I) the moulding or eminence of the door frame against which the door shuts, door-stop (esp. of door-ways
  6. אֲגַף — com. (v. foreg. = גַּף; cmp. b. h. אֲגַפִּים); wing, pinion. Pl. אֲגַפִּים; Du. אֲגַפַּיִים; winged animals, poultry; arms, shoulders of a human being; banks of river &c

[14] suggested form אגרא
Uses:
  14a) אגרא = "Agra" [Aramaic] — in: [אגרא] חמוה דרבי אבא הוה
Candidates:
  1. אֲגַר III (from the word) — foreg.) rent, wages; reward, profit
  2. אִגָר (from the word) — letter, v. אי׳
  3. אַגְרָא II (from the word) — Agra, father-in-law of
  4. אִי II (via אִגָר) — = אִין; h. אִם; cmp. אוֹ); if, whether; adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II
  5. אִי־ (via אִגָר) — prefix, v. אִ־
  6. אִי I (via אִגָר) — fem. of אוּ q. v
  7. אִי III (via אִגָר) — = h. אֵין) not. Git. IV
  8. אִי IV (via אִגָר) — abbr. of אִית, as לי = לית) there is
  9. אֵי II (via אִגָר) — Interj. Eh! Oh! Woe!
  10. אֵי III (via אִגָר) — אֵיי) h. (b. h. אֵי, אַיֵה) where? what? how?—אי מנן whence?

[15] suggested form אגריפס
Uses:
  15a) אגריפס = "Agrippas" [Aramaic] — in: ישראל אמרו עליו על [אגריפס] המלך שעבר מלפני כלה
Candidates:
  1. אַגְרִיפַּס (from the word) — Ἀγρίππας) Agrippa; the last but one Herodian king of Judæa

[16] suggested form אדום
Uses:
  16a) באדום = "upon Edom" [Hebrew] — in: ליה ונתתי את נקמתי [באדום] ביד עמי ישראל וגו
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָדוּם (from the word) — ducat
  2. Klein: אדם (from the word) — to be red; — Qal was red; — Pi. he reddened; — Pu. = was reddened); — Hith. became red, reddened; — Hiph. became red, reddened, blushed
  3. Klein: אָדָם (from the word) — with no. pl.); a man; colloq.) man, mankind; ‘Adam’, name of the first man (according to the Bible)
  4. Klein: אָדֹם (from the word) — red
  5. Klein: אְֹדֶם ᴵ (from the word) — name of a red jewel; carnelian or ruby
  6. Klein: אֹֽדֶם ᴵᴵ (from the word) — red color, redness; lipstick
  7. אָדוֹם (from the word) — אֲדוּמָּה f. (b. h. red
  8. אֱדוֹם (from the word) — pr. n. m. Edom, surname of Esau, son of Isaac; mostly used as a nom. gentil. Edomite, Edomite nation; fem. (sub. מלכות) Rome, Roman government (owing to the dependence of Herod on Rome)
  9. אֲדַם (from the word) — v. הֲדַם. [v. Rabb. D. S. to
  10. אָדַם (from the word) — v. דמם) [to be viscous, thick, dark] to be red, grow red; Pi. to redden, make red; Hif. b. h.) (b. h.) to be, grow red; Hif. to cause to blush, put to shame (usu. הלבין)
  11. הֲדַם (via אֲדַם) — Pa. (אַדֵּם) הַדֵּם; to dissect, dismember, tear to pieces; אֲהַדֵּם (denom. of next w.) to arrange the parts of an animal
  12. הַדָּם (via אֲדַם) — v. preced.) part, member.—Pl. הַדָּמִין, הַדָּמֵי

[17] suggested form אדם
Uses:
  17a) אדם = "men" [Hebrew] — in: דתניא הכוהו עשרה בני [אדם] בעשר מקלות בין בבת
  17b) אדם = "a person" [Hebrew] — in: עד מפי עד ומפי [אדם] נאמן שמא אי אתם
  17c) אדם = "Adam" [Hebrew] — in: לפיכך נברא [אדם] יחידי ללמדך שכל המאבד
  17d) שאדם = "that a person" [Hebrew] — in: של הקדוש ברוך הוא [שאדם] טובע כמה מטבעות בחותם
  17e) אדם = "people" [Hebrew] — in: ברוך הוא טבע כל [אדם] בחותמו של אדם הראשון
  17f) אדם = "man" [Aramaic] — in: שאין דרכן של בני [אדם] להתבונן בדרכים
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָדָם (from the word) — with no. pl.); a man; colloq.) man, mankind; ‘Adam’, name of the first man (according to the Bible)
  2. Klein: אדם (from the word) — to be red; — Qal was red; — Pi. he reddened; — Pu. = was reddened); — Hith. became red, reddened; — Hiph. became red, reddened, blushed
  3. Klein: אָדֹם (from the word) — red
  4. Klein: אְֹדֶם ᴵ (from the word) — name of a red jewel; carnelian or ruby
  5. Klein: אֹֽדֶם ᴵᴵ (from the word) — red color, redness; lipstick
  6. אֲדַם (from the word) — v. הֲדַם. [v. Rabb. D. S. to
  7. אָדַם (from the word) — v. דמם) [to be viscous, thick, dark] to be red, grow red; Pi. to redden, make red; Hif. b. h.) (b. h.) to be, grow red; Hif. to cause to blush, put to shame (usu. הלבין)
  8. אָדָם (from the word) — m. (b. h.) man, pr. n. m. Adam, frequ. א׳ הראשון (abbr. אה"ר)
  9. אֲדָם (from the word) — = דָּם, דְּמָא) blood
